bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d" "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,urllib.request
code='const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path"),{RepoPolicy}=require("/app/server/repo-policy.js"); const p=new RepoPolicy().assertRepo("/workspace/debug-ai"),d=path.join(p,".verification");if(fs.existsSync(d)){const s=fs.lstatSync(d);if(!s.isDirectory()||s.isSymbolicLink()||fs.realpathSync(d)!==d)throw Error("VERIFICATION_SCOPE_UNSAFE");fs.accessSync(d,fs.constants.W_OK);}else fs.accessSync(p,fs.constants.W_OK);const root="/app/runtime/authority/durable/run";console.log(JSON.stringify({parent:p,verification_writable:true,run_ids:fs.readdirSync(root).filter(f=>/^run_[A-Za-z0-9_]+[.]json$/.test(f)).map(f=>f.slice(0,-5))}));'
data=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","debug-ai-debug-ai-1","node","-e",code],text=True))
active=[];unknown=[]
for rid in data.pop("run_ids"):
 try:
  r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/status/"+rid,timeout=3));d=r.get("durable") or {}
  if d.get("active_in_process") or d.get("job_status") in ("RUNNING","RETRY_WAIT","QUEUED"):active.append({"id":rid,"job":d.get("job_status")})
 except Exception as e:unknown.append({"id":rid,"error":type(e).__name__})
print("PREFLIGHT "+json.dumps({**data,"active":active,"unknown_count":len(unknown)}))
if active or unknown:raise SystemExit(3)
PY
git diff --name-only --no-renames "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d" "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d"
